extensions.notes: G-1 TST-0207: live named probes exit 0, receipt state=SUCCESS, per-unit manifest row. Did not run global unit_manifest.py --write. SUCCESS:TST-0207
extensions.question_or_target: Can `.git`, caches, logs, transcripts or unrelated gigabytes enter the distributable? PASS requires an ALLOWLIST-based packer (a denylist is a FAIL by construction) plus a package size ceiling that fails the build.
extensions.title: The packer uses an allowlist and a size ceiling, so `.git` and caches cannot ship

negative_controls.description: Plant .git and a sparse 200MiB junk.bin beside an allowlisted fixture; the allowlist packer must fail and name both. The same allowlist must pack the clean tree.
A denylist of .git/** and *.log would select junk.bin (FAIL by construction). pack() refuses mode=denylist before any walk.
Allowlisted payload.bin of ceiling+64 bytes must fail size_ceiling_bytes and emit no archive. Clean fixture of 97 bytes packs under the 1MiB ceiling.
Widen globs to **; packer must refuse (not an allowlist).
negative_controls.good_state_output: FIXTURE_ALLOWLIST globs accepted; clean pack ok

findings.summary: Packer refuses denylist mode; extras including .git and 200MiB junk.bin fail the build by name.
Uncompressed payload above size_ceiling_bytes fails the build; independent zip listing matches the allowlist.
